notes: New asks what kind of game you want, and platform, shoot-em-up and top-down games start as a small game that already plays. Enemies can flash when hit, shoot only when they see the player, stay gone for the level once defeated, and move slower. One-way tiles, drag tiles to reorder, bigger dynamite blasts, a grid and logo on the Bitmaps page, draggable scroll bars, 80% and 90% sizes for small laptops, and C64 Ultimate 1.2.0+ palettes.
